apple.name: Apple
apple.description: Crispy round fruit with sweet or tart flavor
apple.nutrition: High in fiber and vitamin C
apple.fun_fact: There are over 7,500 varieties of apples worldwide!

banana.name: Banana
banana.description: Long curved tropical fruit with soft sweet flesh
banana.nutrition: Rich in potassium and vitamin B6

orange.name: Orange
orange.description: Round citrus fruit with bright color and juicy segments
orange.fun_fact: Brazil is the largest producer of oranges!

grapes.name: Grapes
grapes.description: Small sweet fruits that grow in clusters on vines
grapes.fun_fact: It takes about 2.5 pounds of grapes to make one bottle of wine!

strawberry.name: Strawberry
strawberry.description: Sweet red fruit with seeds on the outside
strawberry.nutrition: High in vitamin C and antioxidants
strawberry.fun_fact: Strawberries are the only fruit with seeds on the outside!
